title: Connection tests cannot be cancelled once started
existing_state: TestSelectedConnections creates `_connectionTestCts` and handles OperationCanceledException (Form1.cs:8899-8900, 8949-8953), but a repo-wide search shows no code path ever calls `.Cancel()` — the CTS is only created (8899) and disposed (8958-8959). With all checked rows tested at `config.ConnectionTimeout` seconds each, capped to 5 concurrent (SemaphoreSlim(5), 8910), a fleet of unreachable hosts means e.g. 200 hosts x 10s / 5 = ~7 minutes of unstoppable 'Testing...' overlays, during which `_isTestingConnections` (8877) blocks starting another test, and the main Stop button only stops `_sshService` (StopExecution, Form1.cs:13282-13299), not this run.
recommendation: Wire a cancel affordance: morph the status-bar progress area (or grid context menu) into 'Cancel test' while `_isTestingConnections` is true and have it call `_connectionTestCts.Cancel()`; pass the token's cancellation into the per-row visual cleanup so stuck 'Testing...' overlays are cleared. Also guard the result paint at 8935 with the same `hostIpColIndex >= 0` check used at 8922.
user_benefit: Accidentally testing a large checked set against a dead network segment currently locks the feature for minutes with no way out except waiting or killing the app.

evidence.note: CTS created/disposed, OCE handled, but no Cancel() call exists anywhere (verified by repo-wide grep of _connectionTestCts)
StopExecution only stops _sshService, not connection tests
